definition: Visible direct search/fetch or literal curl calls; not nested opaque actions.
Retrieval calls with recorded failure, denial or recognized error text.
Retrieval calls without a recognized return/error state.
Search calls repeating the same tool and visible query from an earlier step; query truncated at 500 characters.
Calls requesting at least one identical page from an earlier step, regardless of result.
Calls requesting a page with an earlier returned fetch; not proof of redundancy.
Calls requesting a page with an earlier failed fetch; a recovery attempt, not necessarily waste.
Unique URLs visible in returned search output, including snippets/navigation; not all necessarily ranked results.
Unique literal requested pages, regardless of status.
Unique page targets of returned calls; not proof of usable page content or HTTP success.
Returned page targets absent from the final answer's URLs; useful background retrieval may be uncited.
Search-output pages requested in a strictly later step.
Search-output pages also named in the final answer.
Unique explicit HTTP(S) URL pages in the complete replayed answer.
Answer URL pages matching a returned fetch target; provenance only, not entailment.
Answer URL pages visible in search output, with no matching returned fetch target.
Answer URL pages visible only in other tool output, with no returned fetch or search match.
Answer URL pages visible only in the prompt.
Answer URL pages absent from visible successful retrieval and prompt; not necessarily hallucinated.
Outer calls in steps before first returned fetch matching a frozen reference URL; URL-only proxy, null when no match.
